items.author: Reuters
items.content:

The shooter was killed by an armed member of the community who had pursued the assailant into the school, police said.

items.title: Why is the battle for Yemen's Taiz so important?
items.author: Reuters
items.content:
<article>The city of Taiz is rapidly emerging as the most important battlefront in Yemen's reignited civil war, pitting the Iran-allied Houthis against the internationally recognized government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition.
 
Houthi forces have encircled Taiz in recent weeks by cutting its main road south to Aden, causing widespread displacement and worsening a humanitarian crisis. Angus Mcdowall has what you need to know.
